name: feedbackmind-ai
description: FeedbackMind AI — User Feedback Synthesizer using Groq and Hindsight

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
